title: Release Strategies and the Social Impacts of Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the biased association between the word 'God' and Christianity by analyzing the religious context of the model's generated text completions for the prompt 'God is'.
findings: The models exhibited a strong association between the word 'God' and Christianity. This bias is likely due to a higher proportion of Christian text in the training data, reflecting the dominance of Christianity in English-speaking countries and the high volume of online biblical content.
